preregistration.title: Confirmatory test of prevalence-gated adaptation with consistency guard (PGA-G) on ASVspoof 5
preregistration.fixed_on: 2026-10-22, before any ASVspoof 5 score was computed
preregistration.prior_evidence: ASVspoof 2021 DF (confirmatory for the gate, PGA_VERDICT_df21.json) and exploratory robustness analyses on ASVspoof 2021 DF and In-the-Wild (EXPLORATORY_PLAN_R1.json) in which the guard was specified; this test is the first on data untouched by the study
preregistration.data: ASVspoof 5 evaluation set, track 1 protocol ASVspoof5.eval.track_1.tsv, all ten flac_E tars (huggingface.co/datasets/jungjee/asvspoof5, mirror of Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.14498691), revision pinned in runs/asv5_v1/config.json
preregistration.detector: authors' SSL-AASIST ASVspoof 2019 LA checkpoint, frozen; score = genuine minus spoof logit; first 64,600 samples
preregistration.precision: fastest of bf16/fp16, TF32, fp32 whose score differs from strict fp32 by at most 0.05 logit on 128 clips

method.classifier: StandardScaler + LogisticRegression(C=0.1, class_weight=balanced), reference-train=1 vs traffic=0, 5-fold cross-fitting
method.anchor: fold-matched conformal anchor on the calibration reference, alpha = 0.05
method.gate: 1 - best-bin genuine-share estimate (frozen score, calibration reference vs traffic) >= 0.80
method.guard: best-bin genuine-share estimate of the adapted score / that of the frozen score >= 0.5
method.decision: adapt only if gate and guard both pass; otherwise frozen score with its conformal anchor

design.reference: 1,000 genuine recordings, random halves 500 train / 500 calibration
design.matched_mode: reference = random genuine recordings pooled over all speakers
design.disjoint_mode: reference = genuine recordings of a random speaker subset (speakers added until 1,000 are available); traffic excludes every trial of those speakers
design.leakage_control: traffic excludes every trial sharing a source utterance (CODEC_SEED, or the file itself if uncoded) with a reference recording
design.traffic: min(12,000, available) trials per repetition at spoof shares 0.05, 0.20, 0.50, 0.80, 0.90, 0.96 and the natural share

hypotheses.H1_gain: matched references, spoof shares 0.90 and 0.96: mean EER(PGA-G) <= 0.85 x mean EER(frozen) and mean anchor HTER(PGA-G) < frozen
hypotheses.H2_no_harm_low_share: matched references, spoof shares 0.05, 0.20, 0.50: mean EER(PGA-G) <= 1.02 x mean EER(frozen)
hypotheses.H3_no_harm_disjoint: disjoint references, every spoof share: mean EER(PGA-G) <= 1.02 x mean EER(frozen) and mean anchor FRR(PGA-G) <= mean anchor FRR(frozen) + 0.01
hypotheses.H4_genuine_rejection: matched references, every spoof share: mean anchor FRR(PGA-G) <= 0.06
hypotheses.H5_shortcut: matched references, every spoof share: mean shortcut AUC of the scores PGA-G uses <= 0.60
hypotheses.decision: H1-H5 all pass -> PGA-G confirmed on ASVspoof 5; otherwise not confirmed (reported in full either way)

secondary_analyses_no_decision: natural spoof share (about 0.80, at the gate threshold), PGA without guard, readout features
guard versus number of reference speakers: disjoint references of exactly 10, 20, 40, 80, 160 speakers and a matched control, 300 recordings, spoof share 0.90, 20 repetitions

held-out breakdown (trials sharing no source utterance with reference or traffic), matched, shares 0.90 and 0.96, 10 repetitions: EER and anchor FRR/FAR by codec and by attack, with Malafide (A18, A20, A23, A30) and Malacopula (A27, A30, A31, A32) attacks reported separately
preregistration.statistics: means over repetitions; 95% percentile bootstrap intervals over repetitions (4,000 resamples, paired for ratios)
